criollo.definition:
n. a Spanish American of pure European stock (usually Spanish)
n. cocoa of superior quality
criollo.translation: n. 生长于拉丁美洲各国的人, 拉丁美洲繁殖的家畜

criollos.definition:
plural of criollo
n. a Spanish American of pure European stock (usually Spanish)
n. cocoa of superior quality
criollos.translation: (criollo 的复数) n. 生长于拉丁美洲各国的人, 拉丁美洲繁殖的家畜

crioscopic method.translation: [化] 冰点降低法(测定分子量)

criosphinx.definition: n. A sphinx with the head of a ram.
